site.sitedescription: Lake is located on Baranof Island in the Alexander Archipelago. Lake is formed in a trough between bedrock ridges. Lake does not appear to have been overridden by glacial ice during the last glaical interval (Marine Isotope Stage 2). Vegetation is dense conifer forest of Tsuga heterophylla, Picea sitchensis, Tsuga mertensiana, Pinus contorta subsp. contorta, and Chamaecyparis nootkatensis.
